about: Labeled questions for the DataReady experiment. 'Now' is Thu 2026-10-22 10:00 IST. Expected outcome: answer (with metric and scope, so the value can be checked), clarify, or decline. See data/PLANTED_ISSUES.md.
changelog: v2 (2026-10-22): B09 and B11 relabeled from decline to answer and renamed A18 and A19. The failed West check covers returns only; orders and AOV don't use returns. The v1 baseline agent answered them with exactly that reasoning, which exposed an over-blocking rule in the engine. The engine now applies a failed quality check only to metrics that use the affected columns.
